Cyprus mapulungnay masakaputay a kanatal (Greece a kamu : Κυπριακή Δημοκρατία；Turkey a kamu :Kıbrıs Cumhuriyeti)u ngangan tu Cyprus (kamu nu Greece , Κύπρος；kamu nu Turkey : Kıbrıs), i tini i Asiaan atu European tu cacaliwaay tu Mediterranean nuwalian a cacay subal akanatal, u ahebal 9,251 km2. (u kamu nu Hulam sa: :Kıbrıs Cumhuriyeti),通稱賽普勒斯(希臘語:Κύπρος；土耳其語:Kıbrıs), .) matinengay u tademaw i Cyprus mauzep nzipaan saayaw taneng a micilim, katukuh i ayaw nu celacan tu 10,000 a mihcaan, itawya a ziday a nadipaan izaw ku Choirokoitia (Ciyaw-i-lu-ke-di-ya, 喬伊魯科蒂亞), u baluhay ba'tuay a ziday masupet tu tukuhay ayza kapah henay ku saluyaluy ku nipatizengay nisangaay, Cyprus zayhan nakakitizaan Mediterranean micumut tu nutipan u Asia a kakitizaan amacebus , namakay sumamadan katukuh ayza u Hittite (Si-tay, 西臺), Assyria (Ya-su', 亞述), Egypt , Persia (Po-se, 波斯), A-la-po-ha-li-ba-uang-caw , U-may-ye-wang-caw Venice atu Turkey Ottoman ti-kuo nu cumudan atu alaen nu icelangay nu tayniay. ayaw nu celacan tu 333 a mihcaan, Alexander tabakiay a hung-ti namakay Persia (Po-se, 波斯) a tademaw na i lima milayap mikuwan tunian a subal, 1878 a mihcaan malingatu u UK ku mikuwanay, katukuh i 1960 a mihcaan pakalatu tu misateket, tucila a mihcaan mala u tabakiay a UK kanatal nu mapulungay a kanatal , Cyprus namisakeket hawsa u angangaan u binacadan Greece a tadenmaw atu cayay kakatuud nu binacadan Turkey a tademaw haymaw satu makacukah a malasawat, katukuh i 1974 a mihcaan, mapuwah pihaceng satu kunicacukah maizang tuni kawaw nu banacadan, angangan mueneng tunian a subal, nuwamisan nu Turkey a tademaw, micalap atu micukep tu i tiniay izaw kuni zuma a patizeng tu sapikuwan tu nuwamisanay a Cyprus atu Turkey mapulungnay masakaputay a kanatal . ayaw i 58 a mihcaan linga'tu, Roma ti-kuo itini patizeng tu Cyprus a kanatal, palalit tu 400 a mihcaan, 395 a mihcaan u ni Byzantine a kanatal, 1489 a mihcaan Venice mapulungnay masakaputay a kanatal mataemut, 1571 a mihcaan nu Turkey Ottoman ti-kuo pakaseneng tuway, 1573 a mihcaan makakelac.1878 a mihcaan nu UK a kamatal pakaseneng tu Cyprus, u UK malinga'tu tu Cyprus makala tu 82 a mihcaan a mikuwan. 1925 a mihcaan namakay UK u kakitizaan nu midebengay.
